column1: # CTF swiss-knife tool manifest  (binaries only — no apt)
# TAB-separated. Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored.
#   version pinned version (recorded next to the binary for idempotency)
#   group   recon | web | pwn   (used by: install.sh --only GROUP)
#   kind    tgz | zip | zip+tgz | raw   (how to unpack the download)
#   bin     file name of the binary inside the archive ('.' = the download itself)
#   url     direct download URL (GitHub release asset — no API call, no rate limit)
#   sha256  sha256 of the DOWNLOADED ARCHIVE (not of the extracted binary)
# Bump a version by editing this file, then re-run:
